'''Hisangi''' (非参議) refers to the following:

# Individuals Ranked {{ill|Junior Third Rank|ja|従三位|ko|종3위|zh|從三位|qid=Q11071123}} ({{ill|Kugyō|2=ja|3=公卿|ja|Kugyō|2=ja|3=公卿|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kugyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Kugyō|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3138036}}) or higher who have not yet been {{ill|ninkan|ja|任官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/appointed|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11267917}} as {{ill|Sangi (Japan)|en|Sangi (Japan)|qid=Q1133663|lt=Sangi}}. This is the most common usage of the term.

* {{ill|benkan|ja|右大弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Udaiben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3270768}} - Hangan of the Daijōkan.
